preconditions: dword_8AC488 (0x008AC488) holds a non-negative scene count; the search is skipped when it is 0.
dword_8AC490 (0x008AC490) points to a contiguous array of scene entries with a 396-byte (0x18C) stride.
Each scene entry holds a NUL-terminated name string starting at offset +260 (0x104), readable byte-wise.
a1 is a NUL-terminated string; SrcStr and v7 are 80-byte locals into which the input and each entry name are copied.
postconditions: If a registry entry's normalized name matches the normalized input, dword_8AC48C (0x008AC48C) is set to that entry's index and 0 is returned.
If no entry matches after scanning dword_8AC488 entries, the function returns dword_8AC488 (the scene count) and dword_8AC48C is left unchanged.
If dword_8AC488 == 0 the search loop is skipped and the function returns 0.
side_effects: Writes dword_8AC48C (0x008AC48C) with the matched scene index, but only when a name match is found.
Reads dword_8AC488 (scene count) and dword_8AC490 (registry base pointer).
Normalizes the input name in a local buffer via sub_589901 before comparison.
Copies each scanned entry name (at +260) into a local 80-byte buffer and normalizes it before strcmp.

lifecycle.owner: scene registry selection; mutates module-global current scene index dword_8AC48C on a match

tests_required: Feed a name matching an existing registry entry; assert dword_8AC48C becomes that entry's index and the return value is 0.
Feed a name matching no entry; assert the return value equals dword_8AC488 and dword_8AC48C is unchanged.
Feed names differing only by the normalization transform (once sub_589901 is evidenced) and assert a match is still found.
Feed an empty registry (dword_8AC488 == 0); assert the return value is 0 and no registry entry is dereferenced.
